issue.title: Agent CLI 有新版本却不显示（Pi 1.4.0 → 1.5.0）：「重新检测」不刷新 latest 的缓存

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### 现象

magpie 0.1.2689（macOS / Apple Silicon，菜单栏 tray 模式，今天 14:54 启动），Agents 页里：

- Claude Code 2.1.310 → 有「更新到 2.1.316」
- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 → 有「更新到 0.2.1-rc.5」
- **Pi 1.4.0 → 没有「更新到 1.5.0」**

顶部那行也只会写「3 个 Agent 有新版本：Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness」，里面没有 Pi。

而 `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.5.0` 是 2026-11-02T11:05Z（本地 19:05）发布的，本地装的是 1.4.0（nvm 下的 npm 全局安装，node v22.21.1）。

### 复现

1. magpie 于 14:54 启动，那时 pi 的 latest 还是 1.4.0；
2. 19:05 pi 1.5.0 发布；
3. 打开 / 切回 Agents 页 → Pi 一行只有 `1.4.0`，没有「更新到 1.5.0」的 pill；
4. 点右上角「重新检测本机的 Agent」两次（20:18、20:30，两次都弹出了「已重新检测 Agent」）→ Pi 依旧没有更新。

只有重启 magpie 才会出现。

### 同一个二进制，新起一个进程就是对的

用同一版本另起一个进程：

```
magpie web --addr 127.0.0.1:3499 --no-open
GET /api/agents/cli
```

返回里 pi 是：

```json
"pi": {
  "version": "1.4.0",
  "latest": "1.5.0",
  "via": "npm",
  "command": "npm install -g --prefix /Users/noxchen/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1 @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@latest",
  "update": true
}
```

所以 pi 的版本检测和更新命令本身都没问题，只是老进程里算出来的 latest 是旧值。

### 怀疑的原因

`agents/cli` 里 latest 的 npm 查询在进程内 memo：新起进程第一次请求耗时 0.6s（真的去问 npm），紧接着几次请求只要 6~8ms（命中缓存）。而 `agents/rescan`（「重新检测」按钮）看起来并没有让这个 memo 失效，于是在 magpie 启动之后才发布的版本，只要缓存没过期、进程没重启，就一直看不到更新，也不会进「N 个 Agent 有新版本」那行。

### 期望

- 「重新检测本机的 Agent」时让 CLI 版本检查的缓存失效（至少把 npm 的 latest 重新问一遍）；
- 或者给 latest 的 memo 一个明确且较短的 TTL（比如 10~30 分钟），并提供一个「检查更新」的入口；
- 现在唯一的解法是重启 magpie，而重启会瞬间断开 127.0.0.1:3425 的网关，正在跑的 agent 会话会被打断。

环境：macOS 26（Apple Silicon）、magpie 0.1.2689、pi CLI 1.4.0（`@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`，npm 全局装在 nvm 的 node v22.21.1 下）。

issue.title: library: ZCode reads ~/.agents/skills too, but magpie doesn't lock the skill for it

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## What

ZCode reads `~/.agents/skills` besides its own `~/.zcode/skills`, but magpie's `readsShared` (`internal/library/targets.go`) doesn't list `zcode`. A skill kept in the shared folder therefore behaves as if ZCode didn't have it.

Repro:

1. Put a skill in `~/.agents/skills` (the user's own entry, or turn on Library → Skills → **Put skills in → shared** and give a skill to any agent).
2. Open Library → Skills. The skill's ZCode chip is not locked, and a click can untick it.
3. Sync. magpie puts a redundant second link in `~/.zcode/skills`, though ZCode already reads the shared entry (its own folder wins that name, so the shared one is shadowed).
4. Hand a shared skill over to the library (`Manage in magpie`): ZCode is not ticked.

Expected, as with Codex and OpenCode: the chip is locked and lit, no second link is made, `Always` names ZCode, and a handover ticks it.

## Evidence from ZCode

ZCode's bundled `app.asar` (`collectUserSkillCandidates`) reads `getUserZcodeSkillRoot` (`~/.zcode/skills`), then `getUserAgentsSkillRoot` (`~/.agents/skills`), dropping a shared entry whose directory name or skill name its own folder already has:

```js
function zh(){return zI(df(),".zcode","skills")}   // getUserZcodeSkillRoot
function zUe(){return zI(df(),".agents","skills")} // getUserAgentsSkillRoot
async function f9(){
  let e=new Set,t=zh(),n=await Zee(t),r=await $Ue(t),o=new Set(n.map(c=>$h(c.name))),
      s=await $ee(n,e),
      a=await $ee((await Zee(zUe())).filter(c=>!r.has(c.directoryName)&&!o.has($h(c.name))),e);
  return[...s,...a].sort((c,d)=>c.directoryName.localeCompare(d.directoryName))
}
```

`resolveAncestorWorkspaceRoots` names both roots (`.zcode/skills`, `.agents/skills`) for each workspace ancestor too.

## Fix

Branch (rebased on current `main`): https://github.com/Ikki6666/magpie/tree/library-zcode-shared-skills — commit `a23828e81`.

- `internal/library/targets.go`: add `"zcode"` to `readsShared`, with the source citation.
- `docs/subsystems/library.md`: add ZCode to the readers list.
- `internal/library/skills_shared_test.go`: `TestZCodeReadsSharedSkills`.

The pull request body is also prepared in that branch's commit, with the before/after behavior per `docs/subsystems/README.md`.

## Verification

- `TestZCodeReadsSharedSkills` fails with the old `readsShared`:

  ```
  zcode reads ~/.agents/skills, yet got a second link: <nil>
  zcode isn't said to have it always: [codex gemini opencode deveco crush dsh]
  ```

  and passes with the change.
- `go test -tags nogui ./internal/library -count=1` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/library 245.641s` (temporary HOME, pinned `GOPATH`/`GOMODCACHE`/`GOCACHE`).
- `gofmt -l` on the changed files → no output.
- `go vet ./...`, `GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui ./...`, `GOOS=windows go vet ./...` → exit 0 (only the existing cgo deprecation warnings).
- `go build`, `GOOS=linux go build -tags nogui`, `GOOS=windows go build` → exit 0.
- Full `go test -tags nogui ./...`: the library package passes; `internal/gateway`, `internal/gui` and `internal/plugin` have failures on this machine that are unrelated (`internal/gateway` and `internal/plugin` don't depend on `internal/library`; the two `internal/gui` failures, `TestLaneLimitRoutes` and `TestProxyCheckSaysAProxyPassedBy`, fail identically on clean `main`).
- Not run: `make test-ui` — no `internal/gui/assets` change.

## Out of scope

Project-level skills: `projectSkillsDirs` says ZCode has no project folder magpie can rely on, while `resolveAncestorWorkspaceRoots` reads each ancestor's `.agents/skills`. That is a separate change.

issue.title: Anthropic endpoint: sending both Authorization and X-Api-Key makes some upstream models (Qwen-Flash) return 403 invalid api-key

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## What happened

Custom provider pointing at an internal Anthropic-compatible gateway, with models `Deepseek-Flash` and `Qwen-Flash`.

In Claude Code, `imported/Deepseek-Flash` works fine, but `imported/Qwen-Flash` always fails:

```
403 {"error":{"message":"<provider>: invalid api-key","type":"permission_error"}}
```

`magpie provider test` reports Qwen-Flash as working, because that test goes through the OpenAI `/chat/completions` endpoint.

## Root cause

Captured what magpie actually sends to the provider's `anthropic` endpoint. It carries **both** auth headers at once:

```
Authorization: Bearer <key>
X-Api-Key: <key>
```

Against this gateway, on the Anthropic endpoint:

- `Authorization` only -> 200
- both headers -> 403 `invalid api-key`
- `Deepseek-Flash` tolerates both headers, `Qwen-Flash` does not

Verified with plain curl, same key, same body:

| model | Authorization only | both headers |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen-Flash | 200 | 403 invalid api-key |
| Deepseek-Flash | 200 | 200 |

The duplicate auth header is what breaks it — not the key, not the model name. (Model name with a `[1m]` suffix was also tested and is unrelated.)

## Workaround that works

```bash
magpie provider set <id> key= "header.Authorization=Bearer <key>"
```

With `key` empty, magpie sends only `Authorization` (verified with a local echo server), and Qwen-Flash returns 200 through the gateway. Downside: the provider loses magpie's multi-key rotation and per-key usage tracking.

## Suggestion

On Anthropic endpoints, send a single auth header (or add a provider option such as `auth-header=authorization|x-api-key`).

Version: magpie 0.1.2767, macOS arm64 (darwin/arm64).

issue.title: agent: /usr/sbin/zed (zfs-zed) is taken for the Zed editor — a false restart notice, and Zed listed as installed

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### What happens

Zed's agent takes `/usr/sbin/zed` — the ZFS Event Daemon that `zfsutils-linux` installs (`zfs-zed.service`, `ExecStart=/usr/sbin/zed -F`) — for the Zed editor, in two separate places:

1. **The process check reports the daemon as a running Zed.** Zed's `Notice` asks the user to restart the editor after a model change; on a machine with zfs-zed running it says so while no editor is open.
2. **Install detection can list Zed from `/usr/sbin/zed`.** When magpie's own PATH holds `/usr/sbin` (a root shell, a container, WSL as root, a distro whose default user PATH has it), `Detected()` takes the daemon for the editor's CLI, and the Agents page has a Zed row on a machine where the editor was never installed.

On a box with `zfsutils-linux`:

```sh
$ ps -o command= -C zed
/usr/sbin/zed -F

$ pgrep -af '(^|/)(zed|zeditor|zed-editor)( |$)'
612 /usr/sbin/zed -F        # zfs-zed; no editor running

$ command -v zed           # in a root shell
/usr/sbin/zed
```

### Where it comes from

`internal/agent/zed.go:137-153`:

```go
func zedProcessNames() []string {
	value := os.Getenv("MAGPIE_ZED_PROCESS_NAMES")
	if value == "" {
		return []string{`(^|/)(zed|zeditor|zed-editor)( |$)`}
	}
```

`agent.Running` (`internal/agent/agent.go:369-379`) hands each pattern to `pgrep -f`, an unanchored ERE matched against the whole command line: `(^|/)` is satisfied by the `/` in `/usr/sbin/zed`, `( |$)` by the space before `-F`. A unit or init script that starts it as `zed -F` matches `^` too. The pattern is loose in general, since `pgrep -f` matches arguments as well — `git -C /work/zed status` and `less ~/notes/zed` count as a running Zed.

Then `internal/agent/zed.go:59-64`:

```go
Notice: func() string {
	if usesMagpie(model()) && Running(processes...) {
		return noticeZed.String()
	}
```

so a real Zed user on a ZFS-root Linux box is told "Restart Zed if it still asks for an API key: magpie has configured its gateway credential in the system credential store." after every model change (the CLI's `magpie zed <model>`, or the window's picker — `internal/gui/api.go:1101-1103` and `1286-1288`), with only the daemon running.

The install side is `Agent.Detected` (`internal/agent/agent.go:401-428`), which ends with:

```go
if a.Bin != "" && a.binsOwn(binAt(a.Bin)) {
	return true
}
```

`binAt` is `proc.LookPath` over magpie's PATH, and the zed agent sets no `binNot` (contrast copilot's, `internal/agent/agents.go:1631-1635`, `binNot: editorLauncher`), so nothing turns the daemon away. Knock-ons: `CLIMissing()` stays false through `cliHeld()` (`internal/agent/gone.go:34-45`), and `BinPath()` gives `/usr/sbin/zed`. No update probe runs today (`zed` is not in `cliSpecs`), so nothing executes it yet — but every question about where Zed's program is gets the daemon.

### Reproduce

Any Linux box with ZFS, or one that only installed the utilities (`apt install zfsutils-linux` brings `/usr/sbin/zed` and starts `zfs-zed`):

1. **process** — with Zed's settings pointing at magpie (`~/.config/zed/settings.json`, `agent.default_model.provider` = `magpie`), change the model and the status line asks to restart Zed, while `ps -C zed` shows only `/usr/sbin/zed -F`.
2. **install** — start magpie from a shell whose PATH has `/usr/sbin` (`sudo -E`, a root container, WSL as root) and the Agents page lists Zed, its CLI at `/usr/sbin/zed`.

### Harms

The notice sends a Zed user chasing a restart that has nothing to do with the daemon; the install row makes magpie offer to connect, and write `~/.config/zed/settings.json` for, an editor that isn't there.

A Windows note, not part of this: `Running` answers true for every pattern there by design (`agent.go:370-372`), so that notice always shows on Windows.

### Suggested fix

- **process** — `Running` is OR-only and pgrep's ERE can't say "not under `/usr/sbin`". Give Zed its own check that reads the command lines (`listRunningNow`/`runningLately` already return them, `internal/agent/running_other.go:13-27`), dropping `/usr/sbin/zed`, `/sbin/zed` and the daemon's `-F` form, and keep `MAGPIE_ZED_PROCESS_NAMES` working.
- **install** — add `binNot` to the zed agent rejecting `/usr/sbin/zed` and `/sbin/zed` (usrmerge makes the second a symlink to the first; `proc.RealPath` first).
- **tests** — `TestZedDefaultsStayStable` (`internal/agent/zed_test.go:376-388`) only pins the pattern string. Add a case with a process list of `/usr/sbin/zed -F` (no notice, settings on magpie) and one with `binAt("zed")` at `/usr/sbin/zed` (not detected).

issue.title: gateway: 工具结果里的图片落在最后一回合时，Vertex AI 回 400 Requests ending with a model turn are not supported（Codex 的 view_image 必挂）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 现象

Codex 0.164.0 经 magpie 走 `google-vertex/gemini-4-argon`，模型一旦调用 `view_image`（工具结果里带图片），**下一次采样请求必回 400**：

```
Google Vertex AI: Requests ending with a model turn are not supported.
```

Codex 重试 5 次（1/5…3/5）全部同一错误，整个回合死掉，用户只能 Esc。凡是"工具返回图片"的回合都会中，等于 Codex 的看图能力在这条链路上完全不可用。

## 环境

- magpie 0.1.1734（Windows）
- Codex CLI 0.164.0（`codex-tui`），`wire_api = "responses"`
- Provider：Google Vertex AI（gcloud ADC），`location = global`，模型 `gemini-4-argon`
- 时间：2026-10-28 14:12–14:15 (+08:00)

## 最小复现

同一模型、同一 provider，只改请求末尾的形状（都只给 16 个输出 token）：

| # | Responses `input` 末尾形状 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| A | `function_call(view_image)` → `function_call_output` 带 `input_image` | **400**（本 issue） |
| B | A 的内容，末尾再跟一条 `message(user, input_text)` | **200**，模型能正确读出图片（回答 "Red"） |
| C | `function_call(exec_command)` → `function_call_output` 纯文本 | 200 |
| D | 图片放在 user 的 `content` 里（普通附件，无 tool 调用） | 200 |

1 张 16×16 PNG、4 张图、900×900 大图、`stream` true/false 都试过，结论一致；只有"图片作为工具结果、且是整条请求最后一项"会挂。

## 用仓库里的 buildVertex 直接 dump 出来的形状

在 `internal/gateway` 里跑 `buildVertex`（`gemini-4-argon`）：

```
A 图片工具结果在最后   -> [user[text]  model[call]  user[response,image]]
B 文本工具结果在最后   -> [user[text]  model[call]  user[response]]
C 图片工具结果+末尾user -> [user[text]  model[call]  user[response,image]  user[text]]
```

## 根因

最后一回合**确实是 user**，`codeassist.go:483` 那条"以 model 回合结尾就补一条 user"的防线没有漏。真正被拒的是：**最后一个 user 回合里 `functionResponse` 与 `inlineData` 混放**。

Google 对"最后一回合里 functionResponse 与别的内容混放"回的就是这句 `Requests ending with a model turn are not supported.` —— 和 #1533 里 `functionResponse` 与 text 混放报的是同一句，`internal/gateway/codeassist.go:446-451` 的注释已经记下过这件事。所以这不是"以 model 回合结尾"，是 Google 复用了同一条错误文本。

相关代码（`internal/gateway/codeassist.go`）：

- **384-428**：`ToolResult` 分支先把 `functionResponse` 追加进 parts，再把该结果携带的图片作为 `inlineData` 兄弟 part 追加到**同一回合**（`toolImage` 标记；401-407 的注释说明这是学 Gemini CLI / Antigravity 的行为）。
- **453-463**：对"带 functionResponse 的 user 回合"只把 **text** 拆到独立回合，图片被 `toolImage` 刻意留在 response 回合里。
- **483-489**：补 user 回合的判定只看 `contents[n-1]["role"] == "model"`，管不到"user 回合里混了图片"这种情形。

## 建议的修法

**方案 1（最小，且与实测吻合）**：把 483 的判定从"最后一回合是 model"扩为"最后一回合是 model，**或**最后一回合带 `functionResponse` 且还带图片"，命中就沿用现有机制补一条 `modelLastAsk(r)` 的纯文本 user 回合。
实测已证明这条思路能过上游：把同一个混合回合放到中间（后面跟一条 user 文本）就是 200。

**方案 2（更彻底）**：工具返回的图片不再与 `functionResponse` 同回合，拆到紧随其后的独立 user 回合，与 text 的处理对齐。代价是与 401-407 注释里保留的 Gemini CLI/Antigravity 行为分叉，需要维护者权衡。

## 影响面

不止 Codex：任何"工具返回图片 + 该结果位于请求末尾"的客户端都会中，比如 Antigravity 的 `view_file`、Gemini CLI 读文件、以及 Claude Code 的图片工具结果经 Responses 桥接进来。Anthropic 侧有 `ag && claude` 分支把图片挪到文字标注之后绕开，Vertex / Code Assist 侧没有对应处理。

## 复现脚本（stdlib only，把 BASE 换成自己的 gateway）

```python
import base64, json, struct, urllib.error, urllib.request, zlib

BASE  = "http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/responses"
MODEL = "google-vertex/gemini-4-argon"
HDRS  = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer magpie",
         "x-openai-actor-authorization": "magpie"}

def chunk(tag, data):
    return struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + tag + data + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)

def png(w, h, rgb):  # a valid PNG without Pillow
    raw = b"".join(b"\x00" + bytes(rgb) * w for _ in range(h))
    return (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
            + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
            + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 6)) + chunk(b"IEND", b""))

RED = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png(16, 16, (255, 0, 0))).decode()
user = lambda t: {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "input_text", "text": t}]}
call = lambda name, args, cid: {"type": "function_call", "name": name,
                                "arguments": json.dumps(args), "call_id": cid}
img_out = lambda cid: {"type": "function_call_output", "call_id": cid,
                       "output": [{"type": "input_image", "image_url": RED}]}
txt_out = lambda cid, o: {"type": "function_call_output", "call_id": cid, "output": o}

def probe(title, items):
    body = {"model": MODEL, "input": items, "stream": True, "max_output_tokens": 24}
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers=HDRS, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=300) as r:
            print(f"[{r.status}] {title}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"[{e.code}] {title}\n        {e.read().decode()[:200]}")

probe("A image tool result last -> 400",
      [user("hi"), call("view_image", {"path": "a.png"}, "c1"), img_out("c1")])
probe("B same + trailing user -> 200",
      [user("hi"), call("view_image", {"path": "a.png"}, "c1"), img_out("c1"),
       user("What colour was that image? One word.")])
probe("C text tool result last -> 200",
      [user("hi"), call("exec_command", {"cmd": "echo hi"}, "c2"), txt_out("c2", "hi\n")])
```
